summary: the fusion source-weight MIN floor is removed, so a source measured significantly negative at every rung of the horizon ladder is weighted by its own evidence instead of being held up at several times it — the floor bound on exactly one live source, the desk's worst-measured, and since that source is a mirror of the only source measured positive, the over-trust was a partial cancellation of the desk's only edge; Buhlmann credibility is now the single continuous thin-sample defence, exactly as ADR-0074 established when it removed this floor's twin (ADR-0087)
